### 1. Scene
The main meal appears to be **four large sushi rolls and two toasted sandwich triangles**, with soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger. I exclude the soup and cake on separate dishes, as requested, and do not count the drinks.

### 2. Vessel
The main dinner plate is approximately **26 cm across**:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

The condiment cups appear approximately **5 cm across**, each with an area of about **20 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The sandwich filling is not clearly identifiable, so its energy estimate includes bread, filling and any toasting fat together.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Toasted sandwich triangles | 25% of plate | 133 × 1.4 = 186 ml | 0.9 | 167 | 280 | 468 |
| Soy sauce | 100% of its cup | 20 × 1.0 = 20 ml | 1.0 | 20 | 55 | 11 |
| Wasabi | 20% of its cup | 4 × 1.2 = 4.8 ml | 1.0 | 5 | 100 | 5 |
| Pickled ginger | 65% of its cup | 13 × 1.5 = 19.5 ml | 0.6 | 12 | 35 | 4 |

### 8. Sanity check
The main-plate footprints total approximately **43% of its area**; the raised rolls and overlapping toast make the plate look fuller. About **334 g on the main plate**, plus **37 g of condiments**, is plausible for the visible portions.

**Estimated total: 371 g and 739 kcal.** The sandwich filling and amount of toasting fat are the largest uncertainties.
